given: an ambulance whose checklist has an item inside a kit, with two identical kit instances in that slot and a second ambulance with none
when: obligations are generated for a day, one kit instance is checked, and an instance is later added, removed or moved between ambulances
then: each instance owes its own obligation, so checking one leaves the other unsatisfied
an ambulance with no instance owes nothing for the item
an instance added or returned inside an open window is owed from the next due instant and a removed one retires only the obligations due after the removal
history queried as-of an earlier instant is unaffected by later additions or removals
notes: issue 92 (https://github.com/JustApu/CheckYourAmbulance-archive/issues/92). Executable evidence today: cya/obligations/tests/test_kits.py and cya/kits/tests. The 'checking one instance' step needs check-to-obligation linking (issue 74 (https://github.com/JustApu/CheckYourAmbulance-archive/issues/74)), so this scenario stays a pending contract until that issue binds it. SPEC §23 has no numbered criterion for kit instances; adding one needs a SPEC amendment, so this is an EX-* scenario citing AC-1.
